title: The Death and Burial of Jacob
description: Jacob instructs his sons to bury him in the cave of Machpelah in Canaan and dies in Egypt. Joseph has his father's body embalmed, and the Egyptians mourn for seventy days. With Pharaoh's permission, Joseph travels up with a large entourage, holds a mourning ceremony at Goren-Ha'atad, and buries Jacob in the cave that Abraham bought, before returning to Egypt.

versions.title: The Death and Burial of Jacob
versions.description: Jacob dies in Egypt after blessing his sons. Joseph brings his father's body back to Canaan and buries him in the cave of Machpelah, as Jacob had requested.
